Hello Hunters and Slugs!

I'm really looking forward to you getting your hands on Mesh Replica. This game is way more fun with your buddies, so call up your friends, group up, and hop into some public matches. Get ready for some laughs!

[img]https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/fr/4/4f/Discord_Logo_sans_texte.svg[/img]

Also, I've set up a [url=https://discord.gg/xkGYr3fSyK]discord server[/url] where we can gather and have a blast together. Join us there for extra fun as we delve into the hunt!
